parameters.content:
## Model Answer: Keeping Your Stack Updated

### Technology Update System

**Monitoring:** n8n release notes, r/n8n, and 2 automation newsletters reviewed every Friday (30 min). New node types and breaking changes logged in a running Notion doc.

**AI model integration:** quarterly review — test new OpenAI/Claude model versions against 2-3 existing production workflows in a duplicate/staging copy before migrating. Track cost-per-call and output-quality delta before switching.

**Tool update procedure:** 1) test in a staging/duplicate workflow, 2) read the changelog for breaking changes, 3) apply the update to production during a low-traffic window (weekends), 4) document what changed and why.

**Continuous learning schedule:** 2 hrs/week total — 1 hr on new n8n features/nodes, 1 hr on home-services/automation industry reading. Certifications and courses logged in a tracker with renewal dates so nothing lapses silently.

**Knowledge sharing:** one written note per month shared to the course community summarizing what changed in the stack and what Jordan tested.

**Next-quarter roadmap:** evaluate AI agent nodes for support ticket triage; pilot with 1 existing client before rolling out to the full client base.
